chapter: Pianists, Basie, Lil Armstrong and closing
title: Basie hiring away Sonny Cohn
summary: Basie took his trumpeter Sonny Cohn, and Saunders was upset until Basie offered arrangements.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Well, to go back to Basie, how did your friendship with Basie develop? Just from seeing each other, or --
No, in Kansas City, I mean, --

Well, after that it was periodic. And then the thing about it, he would steal my men, and I'd get mad as hell, yeah. And when he took Sonny Cohn, that was the thing. That was my first trumpet player. I almost died. But then he'd say, that's all right, I'll send you some arrangements.
